name: New Dingo 22
author: adamgiebl
description: Rounded green checkbox that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks:
Clicking it toggles it: background-color changes from #ffffff2b to #22cc3f, box-shadow becomes #000000 0px 0px 5px inset, #22cc3f 0px 0px 0px 2px inset, #22cc3f 0px 0px 0px 24px inset,
        #e0e0e0 0px 1px 0px 0px, background-color changes from #ffffff2b to #ffffff.
